boundary_evidence: contiguous linker run: .text 0x020731fc..0x0207322c, 2 functions (std::terminate, std::dthandler), gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. The .data word 0x0209a6fc (std::thandler) belongs to the file but stays ROM bytes; see notes.

DATA: the word at 0x0209a6fc holds 0x02073220 (dthandler) in the ROM and is read by terminate, the only code in the tree that refers to it. MSL's NMWException.cp declares `static terminate_handler thandler = dthandler;` beside dthandler and terminate, so the three belong to one file.
SOURCE ORDER: mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order; MSL defines dthandler before terminate, and dthandler sits above terminate here.
BOTTOM EDGE: __register_global_object (0x020731dc), which MSL keeps in global_destructor_chain.c and Spirit Tracks' decomp gives a file of its own with __global_destructor_chain's .bss.
TOP EDGE: func_0207322c (0x0207322c) returns the address of the soft-float status word data_020aa3f4, which is not exception-handling code.
notes: Text-only. MSL's dthandler and thandler are static and thandler (`= dthandler`) is defined in this file. Owning that .data word needs the intact-object production path, and with it a tubuild linkcheck proof; that linkcheck stops on the missing `linkcheck --baseline` vtable-partition proofs of five unrelated TUs (arm9/dBgCh_Gnd, dBgCh_Lin, dBgCh_SphCrr, ov036/daObjRcCarpet_c, ov070/daPropeller_Heyho_c). Until then thandler is declared extern and dthandler keeps external linkage, since the ROM word's R_ARM_ABS32 reaches it from outside the object. Follow-up: an intact-object promotion that owns .data 0x0209a6fc..0x0209a700 and restores both statics.

Not folded: __throw_catch_compare (0x02072fcc), the next MSL function in NMWException.cp, sits below __register_global_object. Either __register_global_object is in this file in this MSL, or __throw_catch_compare is in another file; nothing in the ROM settles which.
